business.name: Flourish Bakehouse
business.tagline: Bread out of the oven at six. Gone by noon.

services.name: Daily Loaves
services.description: Sourdough, seeded rye, and a rotating third loaf posted each morning.

services.name: Pastry Case
services.description: Croissants, kouign-amann, and whatever fruit is good that week.

services.name: Whole Cakes
services.description: Made to order with three days' notice, for pickup only.

about.story: We are a five-person bakery with one deck oven, which is the honest reason we sell out. Everything is mixed the afternoon before and baked starting at three in the morning.
